summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: botocore/regions.py adds the EndpointResolverBuiltins str-Enum with the eleven members; botocore/args.py makes the STS predicate accept a None endpoint config, imports the enum, and adds ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults; tests/unit/test_args.py adds TestEndpointResolverBuiltins. Targeted tests (test_args, test_regions, test_client) pass: 416 passed. Full tests/unit run: 3143 passed, 11 failed, 66 skipped. The 11 failures (test_awsrequest FakeSocket.settimeout, test_session/test_session_legacy test_internal_component) also fail on the stashed baseline, so they predate this change. Nothing committed. The misleadingly named SDK-endpoint test sets the bundled-data flag to False, as the spec requires; its name follows the spec. The helper calls the bridge's private variant and DualStack lookups, since the spec requires reusing them.
